title: What clients say
subtitle: A signed recommendation, and verified reviews from my Upwork clients

letter.excerpt: He has been an invaluable asset, very smart, humble, and responsive. I could not have asked for anything more from a developer.
body: Bipu has been working with our team for close to a year now. He has been an invaluable asset, very smart, humble, and responsive. I could not have asked for anything more from a developer.

The project is currently paused for an undetermined amount of time, so right now we don't have work for him, but I hope he will be available if/when the project resumes! What I do know is that he always made himself available any time of the day or night to help us with any production problems and was able to calmly and quickly work through any issues. I cannot say enough good things about him, and I know that any team he joins will enjoy the same benefits that we did.
letter.author: Paul Papasavas

reviews.quote: Biplob is an excellent full-stack PHP Laravel developer. He quickly understood our project requirements, delivered clean and efficient code, and communicated clearly throughout the contract. His skills in Laravel, Vue.js, and API integration were exactly what we needed. Highly recommended for any full stack PHP, Laravel Vue.js development project!
